summary: Apogee Enterprises filed an 8-K disclosing a Share Purchase Agreement dated September 2, 2026, to acquire 100% of SIA Alzette, which owns SIA Groglass, a Latvian anti-reflective coatings provider, via a newly formed subsidiary. The transaction values Groglass at approximately €62.5 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis, with up to €10 million in contingent earnout based on three-year performance targets. Financing will use cash on hand and existing credit facility. Closing is expected in Apogee's fiscal Q3 2027, subject to customary conditions. The deal includes ancillary employment and restrictive covenant agreements. Watch for regulatory approvals and earnout achievement, with risk-arb focused on closing timeline and purchase price adjustments.
